Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-transcribe-medium-0126", "row_sha256": "7c508d8a0b8c9ce6834740eeba372b27fc599baad0101307859d4e5ed86d025b", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "i'm updating the watering rota for the west greenhouse because the early tomatoes are drying out faster than the beds by the door and we have three people covering the next few mornings. on monday lena can start with the tomato benches and check the narrow tray beside the heater because that one stayed wet last week. on tuesday i can take the herb tables before the delivery arrives, but only if the hose connector is back on the blue cart. please send the revised rota to Bram not Saskia so nobody forwards the older version from the notice board. the north end needs a light watering after lunch, not before opening, and the seedlings on the lower shelf should be checked by hand because the timer misses that row. if the rain barrel is still below the marked line, use the tap for the main aisle and leave the small cans near the potting bench. we should keep the Friday slot open until Omar confirms whether he can come in, and then add his name beside the evening check. i haven't changed the weekend section yet because the glasshouse crew may swap their shift, so leave those boxes as they are for now. i'll bring the printed copy when i come by after the morning inspection.", "output": "I'm updating the watering rota for the west greenhouse because the early tomatoes are drying out faster than the beds by the door, and we have three people covering the next few mornings. On Monday, Lena can start with the tomato benches and check the narrow tray beside the heater because that one stayed wet last week. On Tuesday, I can take the herb tables before the delivery arrives, but only if the hose connector is back on the blue cart. Please send the revised rota to Bram, not Saskia, so nobody forwards the older version from the notice board. The north end needs a light watering after lunch, not before opening, and the seedlings on the lower shelf should be checked by hand because the timer misses that row. If the rain barrel is still below the marked line, use the tap for the main aisle and leave the small cans near the potting bench. We should keep the Friday slot open until Omar confirms whether he can come in, and then add his name beside the evening check. I haven't changed the weekend section yet because the glasshouse crew may swap their shift, so leave those boxes as they are for now. I'll bring the printed copy when I come by after the morning inspection."}]
